chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdillah, from Al-Hasan, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abū al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام: “Will you not guide me to the one from whom I should take my religion?”
So he said: “This is my son, ‘Alī. Indeed, my father took me by the hand and brought me to the grave of Rasūl Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, then said: ‘O my son,’”
“Indeed, I am placing upon the earth a خليفة.”
And indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, when He says a word, He fulfills it.

key_terms.اِبْنِي: my son; indicating filial succession in the context of designation
key_terms.خَلِيفَةً: vicegerent/successor; one appointed by Allah with authority on earth
key_terms.دِينِي: my religion; the body of belief and practice to be taken from a rightful authority
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: ‘Alī; the named son identified here as the authority to be followed
key_terms.قَبْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم; the sacred setting in which the designation is recalled
key_terms.قَوْلًا: a word/decree; Allah’s decisive statement or command
key_terms.وَفَى: fulfilled; carried out completely and unfailingly

ai.seo_question: Whom did Imam Abū al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام appoint as the religious authority after him?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام directing the questioner to his son ‘Alī as the religious authority to follow. It connects that designation to the Qur’anic declaration of a divinely appointed khalīfah on earth, emphasizing that Allah’s decree regarding succession and authority is fulfilled without fail.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Al Hassan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Is’haq Bin Ammar, said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, ‘Will you<sup>asws</sup> not point me to the one<sup>asws</sup> from whom I should be taking my Religion?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This son<sup>asws</sup> of mine<sup>asws</sup>, Ali<sup>asws</sup>. My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> grabbed me<sup>asws</sup> by my<sup>asws</sup> hand and took me<sup>asws</sup> to the grave of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>!
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [2:30] And when your Lord said to the Angels, I am going to Make a Caliph in the earth
, and surely when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Says (some) Words, He<sup>azwj</sup> Fulfils it’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from al-Hassan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following.
“I said to abu al-Hassan the 1st (a.s.) Would you guide me to a person from whom would learn my religion.”
He said, “This is my son Ali. My father took my hand until we were in the shrine of the Messenger of Allah and said, “My son,
Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, “. . I am appointing someone as my deputy on earth,. .” [2:30]
When Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, says a word He keeps His word.”
